I am writing to express my strong disappointment regarding my recent stay. As a Diamond Elite member, I expect a standard of service and hospitality that reflects loyalty and status, but my recent experience fell far short.
​Check-In & Recognition: The welcome experience was entirely lacking. I was simply handed my key card without the customary hospitality or warmth expected for Diamond members.
​Suite Upgrade Handling: Upon requesting an upgrade, I was flatly denied despite suites showing availability. This is not an isolated incident—it has happened repeatedly during past stays. It strongly felt as though foreign nationals were being prioritized over local Indian guests for upgrades and attentive service.
​Severe Dining Hygiene Issues: The breakfast service was deeply concerning. I observed non-vegetarian and vegetarian items in direct physical contact with each other, with omelets and dosas literally overlapping on the cooking line. Cross-contamination of this nature is completely unacceptable, and as a result, I was forced to skip breakfast entirely.
​Room Layout: The room was acceptable, though notably congested for a premium tier experience.
​As a loyal member, I expect my status to be respected and basic food hygiene standards to be strictly enforced.

Very disappointing parking policy by Hilton.

I came to the hotel to drop a guest. I had a private car with a driver, but the hotel refused to allow the car to be parked because the driver was present. They said parking is allowed only if the guest comes without a driver.

If the car belongs to the guest and the guest is staying at the hotel, why should having a driver make the car ineligible for parking? This makes absolutely no sense.

When I parked the car outside, traffic police came and told us to park the car at the place we were visiting — which was Hilton itself. But Hilton’s management refused to allow the car inside.

A hotel of Hilton’s standard should have a much more sensible and guest-friendly parking policy. This entire experience was unnecessarily frustrating and embarrassing.

Shame on Hilton management for such a ridiculous policy.

Despite repeated reminders and complaints, no one bothered to check if the issue had been resolved or even whether I was comfortable. The complete lack of follow-up and concern for a guest's experience is unacceptable, especially from a hotel that prides itself on its reputation.

I rarely take time out of a busy day to write reviews while I'm still staying at a property, but the level of service I experienced truly warrants one. I expected far better from Hilton, and this stay has been a major disappointment.

Our experience at the Grand Hyatt Mumbai was absolutely terrible from the moment we arrived.

Firstly, when we checked in at around 4pm, the receptionist who attended to us looked visibly tired and exhausted. There was no warmth, energy or welcoming attitude whatsoever. For a hotel of this standard, the first impression was incredibly underwhelming.

Things only got worse after we were given our rooms. We dropped off our bags and immediately headed out. When we returned later, we walked into an unbearable smell of dampness and fresh paint. The smell was so overwhelmingly strong that our eyes actually started burning.

What made this even more unacceptable was that the smell was not there when we initially entered the room and dropped off our bags. It became obvious that they had decided to carry out painting or maintenance work while we were already checked into and assigned the room.

How can a five-star hotel knowingly expose paying guests to such strong paint fumes? Carrying out painting work in or around an occupied guest room and then expecting guests to sleep in those conditions is completely unacceptable. The room was not fit to stay in, let alone sleep in.

For a Grand Hyatt property, this level of service and basic consideration for guests is honestly shocking. We expected a luxury hotel experience and instead were greeted by exhausted staff and a room filled with damp, toxic-smelling paint fumes that literally caused our eyes to burn.

A hugely disappointing experience and certainly not what you would expect from a supposedly five-star hotel.

The pool is nice, but the first time I went there, nobody was available to provide sun loungers or towels. The rooms are spacious and the beds are comfortable, but the interiors feel somewhat dated; you can really notice the hotel’s 25 years of age.

The only truly positive aspect was breakfast, which offered good quality and a wide selection.

We stayed at Trident BKC for my mom’s visa interview, and the experience was truly exceptional. Although it was an expensive stay, for our purpose it was absolutely worth the money  quality, comfort, convenience, and most importantly, the incredible hospitality of the staff.

My mom’s visa interview was scheduled very early at 7:00 AM, and one of the biggest advantages of staying here was being so close to the U.S. Consulate. From our room, we could actually see the lines forming outside in the morning, which took away so much of the stress of having to travel across Mumbai for such an important appointment.

Her interview process took much longer than expected, and she did not come out until around 11:00 AM, so our family ended up missing breakfast. When the hotel staff learned about our situation, they very kindly arranged breakfast for us in our room even though breakfast hours had already ended. That gesture alone meant a lot to us after such a stressful morning.

But what made the stay truly unforgettable was Shraddha, the manager. Before checkout, she personally came to our room to ask how our stay had been. At almost that exact moment, I was on the phone with my husband, who was waiting outside the Consulate for my mom. From the hotel, I could see my mom finally coming out, and we learned that her visa had been approved. It was such an emotional and happy moment for our family.

Shraddha understood what was happening and immediately asked if the hotel could arrange a small surprise for us. She requested that I give them a little time, and shortly afterward they had arranged floating balloons, a beautiful flower bouquet, and our missed breakfast in the room.

What started as a stay for a stressful visa interview suddenly turned into a beautiful visa celebration at Trident BKC. My mom was downstairs at the time, so everything was ready when she came back. We were able to celebrate her visa approval together right there in the hotel, and it became one of the most memorable parts of our entire experience.

It turned an already unforgettable day into something magical for our entire family. After all the anticipation and stress surrounding the visa interview, being able to celebrate such an important milestone together at Trident was incredibly special.

A huge thank you to Shraddha and the entire Trident BKC team for going far beyond what we expected. Their kindness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail are something we will always remember.

For anyone coming to Mumbai for an early-morning appointment at the U.S. Consulate, especially for something as important and stressful as a visa interview, I would highly recommend staying here. Excellent location, excellent comfort, outstanding service and hospitality with a genuinely human touch.

We came to Trident for a visa interview and left with a beautiful visa celebration and memories we will cherish forever. Worth every penny for us. ❤️

Мы приехали сюда на шахматный турнир — я сопровождал пятерых детей. Мы сами из Узбекистана, из Центральной Азии. До приезда переживали прежде всего из-за безопасности, питания и того, насколько комфортно здесь будет детям. В итоге все опасения оказались напрасными.

Номера отличные, просторные и комфортные. Всё необходимое есть, уборку проводили каждый день. Спасибо всей команде гостиницы за гостеприимство и прекрасное отношение к детям. Всем друзьям из Узбекистана и других стран Центральной Азии смело рекомендую эту гостиницу. Мы остались очень довольны!

I’ve stayed at several Taj properties and have always associated the brand with warm, intuitive hospitality, which is why my experience at Taj Santacruz was disappointing.

I had two consecutive reservations and was specifically asked at check-in to return to reception the following day simply to revalidate my room key. When I did exactly that, I was unexpectedly asked to produce my ID again to verify my identity. While I understand that hotels have security protocols, the entire interaction felt unnecessarily cumbersome and was handled without the warmth or ease I would expect from a five-star Taj property.

What was even more disappointing was when I asked to speak with a manager whom I had previously seen approaching guests at breakfast and inviting them to reach out if they needed anything. While a staff member was calling him, I could hear him asking, “Who’s calling me? What do they want?” The tone came across as irritated rather than welcoming, which was particularly unpleasant when I was simply asking for assistance.

He did eventually come over, explain that the ID requirement was protocol and apologise, which I appreciate. However, hospitality is not only about following procedures: it is also about how guests are made to feel while those procedures are carried out. Unfortunately, the overall experience felt transactional and lacking in the genuine warmth I have experienced at other Taj hotels.

Terrible Billing Practices and Zero Accountability – Avoid This Property

Our experience with the JW Marriott Mumbai Sahar has been utterly disappointing. We booked two fully refundable rooms and canceled well in advance of the deadline, receiving an official cancellation confirmation clearly stating a $0 / zero balance due.

Despite this, the hotel wrongfully charged our account for one night for both rooms. It has now been two months of chasing them for our money ($400) back. While Reservation Executive Komal Waghela admitted the charge was a mistake and agreed in writing via email to process the refund, absolutely nothing has happened. Empty promises, endless delays, and zero follow-through.

It is completely unacceptable for a luxury property of this caliber to hold guests' money hostage through unauthorized charges and incompetent billing resolution. If you book here, keep a very close eye on your credit card statements. Until our refund is finally processed and credited, I cannot recommend staying at this hotel.

reviews.text:
I recently completed another stay at this hotel and, overall, had a very enjoyable experience. Several of my colleagues were also staying at the property during this visit, and we all had positive experiences.

The rooms are comfortable, the beds are excellent, and having a bathtub made the stay especially relaxing. One feature I particularly appreciated was being able to connect my Amazon Fire Stick to the television, which helped make the room feel more like home. The hotel is also extremely convenient to the airport, making it a great choice for business travelers.

There were many highlights throughout my stay. The check-in process was seamless and professional, the Executive Lounge staff were exceptionally warm, attentive, and welcoming, housekeeping provided excellent service, and the breakfast offerings were delicious and well prepared with plenty of variety. These strengths combined to make for a comfortable and memorable stay.

As a Lifetime Titanium Elite member, I was somewhat disappointed not to receive a room upgrade. In comparison to my experiences at properties such as The St. Regis Mumbai, The Westin Mumbai Powai Lake, and JW Marriott Mumbai Juhu, upgrades seem to be less frequent here. During my stays, I have typically only received an Executive Club level upgrade rather than a suite upgrade, despite my loyalty status and use of the Marriott Bonvoy app for check-in.

I would also suggest some enhancements to the Executive Lounge food offerings. While the service from the lounge team is outstanding, the food selection feels somewhat basic compared to other premium Marriott properties. A more efficient live-cooking station and a broader selection of Western dishes would further elevate what is already a very good lounge experience.

Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and greatly appreciate the hospitality extended by the entire team. This is a well-managed property with comfortable accommodations, excellent service, and a convenient location. With a few small improvements, particularly around elite member recognition and lounge dining options, it could deliver an even more exceptional guest experience.

### A beautiful hotel let down by a poor arrival experience

I recently stayed at Fairmont Mumbai and came away with mixed feelings. The hotel itself is impressive — beautifully designed, spacious rooms, excellent in-room facilities and outstanding housekeeping. The F&B team was also a highlight, with courteous servers and the small, personal interactions that make guests feel genuinely welcomed.

Unfortunately, the arrival experience was far below the standard expected from a luxury property.

I arrived around 11:15 pm after a long journey for a summit, with details of both travellers already provided and confirmation received. I waited 5–10 minutes for luggage assistance and then another 15 minutes while the Front Office tried to locate my reservation. Despite showing the QR code provided by the organisers, there was considerable confusion, little communication and no sense of ownership.

It eventually became clear that although the organisers had provided the guest list, the individual reservation had not been properly created in the hotel's system. Even after the second traveller's name was located, it took additional time to arrange the room. An 11:15 pm arrival eventually resulted in a room only after almost an hour.

What was particularly disappointing was the absence of basic hospitality during the wait. No water was offered. Only after around 45 minutes did the Duty Manager ask whether I would like some. For a tired guest arriving late at night, this should ideally have been an automatic courtesy.

I understand that hotels can be busy, sold out, or face booking issues. The concern is how such situations are handled. A luxury hotel should be able to manage an unexpected problem with proactive communication, empathy, ownership and service recovery.

There was also a serious concern with breakfast. I had eggs, cereals, fruits and nuts before checkout and subsequently experienced what appeared to be food poisoning. I cannot establish the cause, but some nuts tasted noticeably rancid and the cereals did not seem particularly fresh. I therefore believe the hotel's food freshness and safety controls would benefit from review.

To be fair, this is not a criticism of the entire hotel. The rooms, interiors, facilities, housekeeping and several F&B team members were excellent.

For a hotel of this stature, luxury hospitality is ultimately tested when something goes wrong. Unfortunately, the arrival experience and subsequent food-related illness significantly affected my overall impression.

I had considered Fairmont Mumbai for a future family stay, but after this experience, I would unfortunately think twice.

**Overall: an excellent property with very good rooms, housekeeping and F&B service, but a disappointing Front Office arrival and service-recovery experience, along with a concerning breakfast-related illness.**

It feels like the Great Gatsby! Opulent and lavish. But sadly filled with unrequited love, fake Americanized Indian Dream, and deep loneliness.

Anyhow... i digress. Forgive me... As I sat in the lobby waiting, a child happened to be crying in the lobby area... A perfectly normal human happening that is to be expected. But his sound reverberated through the whole lobby and it dawned upon me that the designers may have gone for show and tell, and failed to consider a desirable human experience of rest, ease, beauty and calmness that is created by good management of sound. More so when reaching the hotel from the highway seems like a feat akin to surviving a ride in an unexpected amusement park next to the airport.

We sat in the Madeline for lunch; t'was early. There was not a single other guest and the beauty and expansiveness, the design and taste, altogether hit me again with its gorgeous art deco. Yet, my eyes kept veering to this towering large elecronic screen with stunning visuals... Alll very beautifully curated, yet again - the use of AI transformed the experience into one of a niggling irritant that simply wouldn't leave me alone... Like a small stone in fancy shoes. Who cares? They hurt no matter what!

--- I ask ---
Why? Oh why? Do we do this?
Think I am far too old fashioned and sensitive, peculiar and weird, to be able to appreciate and comment in this manner. My apologies...

I will end, nevertheless, and share with you the chill left in my bones even 8 hours later. The kind that cuts, and penetrates and leaves you cold and dark, feeling alone and lonely. Thankfully, the warmth of the conversation and the tasty Indian food somewhat helped to alleviate the angst of the contrasting experiences.

Great looking hotel! But it didn't feel so great. Do something please. Let this not be the Great Gatsby! Beneath its glittering presentation of Jazz Age, it was a story built on profound loneliness, unrequited longing, and the failure of dreams.

Our stay at Kohinoor Continental genuinely felt like a 5-star experience, especially considering the overall service and the way our luggage was handled right from check-in to the room. The check-in process was smooth and easy, and the staff made the entire arrival experience feel very comfortable and well-managed.

The room layout was excellent, the TV was quite large, and the overall ambience of the hotel was amazing. However, the TV isn’t a Smart TV, which unfortunately makes it almost useless for entertainment beyond basic channels. If you’re planning to relax with a movie or series on OTT after a long day, it definitely takes away from the experience and spoils the entertainment mood.

The food is definitely on the expensive side, but the quality is top-notch. We ordered pizza and chai one day, and the pizza was absolutely delicious—we loved it! They also served us cookies, which were really nice and a thoughtful touch.

The location is another big plus. There are plenty of restaurants nearby, and the hotel is situated on a busy, convenient street, so getting around and finding places to eat is very easy. It was also quite convenient to get to the airport from the hotel.

The only other concern I had was the Wi-Fi. I tried working using the hotel Wi-Fi, but the connection and overall performance weren’t really up to the mark.

Apart from these minor issues, it was an excellent stay with great service, amazing ambience, a convenient location, and a very smooth overall experience. Definitely felt closer to a 5-star experience than what I expected!

**⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An outstanding family buffet dinner at Solitaire Restaurant**

We recently enjoyed a wonderful buffet dinner at Solitaire Restaurant with our family, and it exceeded every expectation. From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel genuinely welcome and well taken care of. They were attentive without being intrusive, quickly helping us with seating, explaining the spread, and checking in throughout the evening to ensure everything was perfect. Their warm and professional service truly elevated the whole experience.

The buffet itself was excellent—fresh, abundant, and thoughtfully arranged. There was a great variety of starters, live counters, main courses (both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options), and a tempting dessert section. Everything tasted freshly prepared, well-seasoned, and of high quality. We especially appreciated how the dishes kept coming out hot and how the counters were promptly replenished. It was easy for everyone in the family, from kids to elders, to find something they loved.

The ambiance was pleasant and comfortable, making it ideal for a relaxed family dinner. The overall value for the quality and quantity of food was outstanding. We left completely satisfied and already looking forward to our next visit.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a delicious buffet experience with excellent service. Thank you to the entire team at Solitaire Restaurant for making our family evening so memorable!

I wanted to take a moment to appreciate Kshitij, Leonard, Jay and Ash at The Mirador Hotel, Andheri.

To be very frank, my experience at the hotel was not entirely a positive one. There was an unfortunate situation which I feel happened because of some misunderstanding and maybe some lack of clarity from both sides. I dont think it would be fair to entirely blame the hotel, and neither can I say that I was completely right. Sometimes these things just happen and situations get misunderstood.

But what really stayed with me was how everything was handled afterwards.

Kshitij, Leonard, Jay and Ash handled the entire situation with a lot of dignity, patience and most importantly respect. At no point I felt that they were just trying to manage me or get rid of the situation. There was a genuine sense of empathy in the way they spoke and dealt with everything, and honestly that touched me.

Its very easy to write a good review when everything goes perfectly. But I think it says much more when something actually goes wrong, and you still walk away wanting to appreciate the people involved.

For me that speaks volume about these four gentlemen and also the culture of the property.

Inspite of what happened, the way they navigated the entire situation actually changed the way I felt about the experience. I walked away without any bitterness towards the hotel. Infact, I left with respect and goodwill, and I would have no hesitation coming back to The Mirador in the future.

Sometimes you may forget what exactly went wrong, but you dont forget how someone treated you when things were not going right.

Kshitij, Leonard, Jay and Ash — thank you for treating me with dignity and respect. I genuinely appreciate it and wish you guys the very best.
